text:
Type: round shaggy high-pile rug
Use: softening a floor spot, under a coffee table or beside a bed; living room, bedroom, nursery
Style: contemporary, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: thick long shag pile yarn
Colors: light warm beige, off-white
Shape: circular, deep plush shag, solid color, soft rounded edge, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, soft, airy, calm
Goes with: white walls, light wood, cream and pale grey textiles; Scandinavian or minimalist bedrooms and living rooms

product.name: DUM
product.description: The dense, thick pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
